newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ARBONALE BIDS FOR SHIPPER, N-TERMINAL JOINS.
newsitem.headline: ARBONALE BIDS FOR SHIPPER, N-TERMINAL JOINS.

text.p: Arbonale, the bidding vehicle for one of the consortia seeking to purchase Estonian Shipping company, confirmed on Thursday that it was the second bidder for the shipping company.

"We also placed a bid and we have also expanded our consortium to include Talinvest and we have brought N-Terminal in with a strategic agreement, " Toomas Reisenbuk, executive director of Hansa Investments, advising on the deal, told Reuters.
Hansa Investments, also one of the consortium members, said that N-Terminal's participation was very important for the bid.
"N-Terminal, a port handling company, is locally owned and a very strong company and will give strength to our approach," Reisenbuk added.
"N-Terminal has been selected to be the party to develop further the rail, handling and container services and to integrate Estonian Shipping into transit trade," he said.
The consortium also brought in Talinvest, a Baltic based investment house.
"With Talinvest and N-Terminal we have a very strong bid," Reisenbuk said.
The consortium includes Jinhiu Shipping and Transport Ltd., Nomura, Hansa Invesments and Norwegian shipping group Marsoft.
Reisenbuk said they will not reveal any details of their bid as the decision on who buys the shipper may take two weeks.
The privation agency earlier told Reuters that a decision may be announced on June 11.
